meta.title: Activity analytics
meta.description: Local profile-wide time tracking for your activity and all agents, with calendar and custom ranges.

ui.subtitle: Time spent here. Across every conversation.
ui.youHelp: Estimated focused-window presence, not manual work
ui.agentsHelp: Summed across all agents, including subagents
ui.error: Could not load analytics. Try again.
ui.activityError: Activity has not synced. Retrying automatically; keep this window open.
ui.volatile: Browser backup is unavailable. Pending activity is only in memory; keep this window open until it is saved.
ui.recoveryError: A browser backup could not be read. It was preserved, not deleted. Some earlier activity may be missing.
ui.invalid: Choose a valid date range. The end date must not precede the start date.
ui.ruleUser: Your time estimates presence, not attention or manual work. A visible, focused DSH window starts with a 5-minute grace period even before input. Trusted interaction renews it. Typing, clicking, scrolling, touch, text input and pointer movement are detected across DSH: chats, settings, previews and sidebars. After 5 minutes without input, counting pauses, even if you are still reading. Automatic page scrolling does not renew this timer. Embedded external pages may isolate their input; see the browser limitation below.
ui.ruleAgent: Agent time measures running tasks, including model calls, tools and waits. Parallel agents add up: three agents running for 10 minutes mean 30 agent-minutes. Detached jobs after an agent becomes idle are not included.
ui.ruleDates: Periods use this device’s local calendar. 7, 14 and 28 days include today. The custom end date is inclusive. Tracking starts at installation; earlier activity is not reconstructed.
ui.rulePrivacy: Only timestamps and durations are stored, not text, keys, clicks or page contents. Sleep and long timer gaps are skipped. Abrupt closure may lose the latest unsynced seconds.
ui.ruleBrowser: The browser guest is isolated from DSH. Activity inside an external embedded page is not guaranteed to renew the 5-minute timer. No page content or browsing history is read.
ui.noData: No recorded time in this period yet.
